Карту «где взять» обучили на одной демон: A “where to pick” map was trained on a single demonstration in which the operator picks up a red cube. In a new scene the cube lies in a different corner of the table. Where will the map put its peak, that is, where will the robot pick?
На кубике в новом месте: фильтр карты од: On the cube in its new place: the map’s filter is the same in every cell
Там, где кубик был в демонстрации: Where the cube was in the demonstration
Нигде: одной демонстрации мало: Nowhere: one demonstration is not enough
Полносвёрточная карта эквивариантна сдви: A fully convolutional map is translation-equivariant: move the cube and the peak of the map moves with it. Coordinate regression in the same lab reached for the spot from the demonstration.
Действие — клетка на картинке: An action is a cell in the image
Как CLIP находит предмет по описанию, ко: How does CLIP find an object from a description that never appeared in its training?
Вектор описания складывается из векторов: The description vector is assembled from word vectors, and it encodes image features separately
Он запоминает все картинки из интернета: It memorizes every image on the internet
Он дообучается на каждом новом описании: It is fine-tuned on every new description
Контрастное обучение кладёт картинки и п: Contrastive training puts images and captions in one space. A new combination of familiar features lands where the sum of the words points: that is how mini-CLIP found the purple cube.
Картинки и подписи в одном пространстве: Images and captions in one space
На столе два одинаковых кубика. Регресси: There are two identical cubes on the table. Coordinate regression and a map were trained on demonstrations in which the operator picked sometimes one, sometimes the other. Where does the regression land?
Между кубиками, в пустое место: Between the cubes, on empty table
В тот кубик, что ближе к роботу: On the cube closer to the robot
Регрессия выдаёт среднее, а среднее двух: Regression outputs the mean, and the mean of two cubes is the empty spot between them. The map has two peaks, and the robot picks one of them.
Как Transporter находит поворот, под кот: How does Transporter find the rotation at which the part fits into the socket?
Строит карты для 36 повёрнутых копий выр: It builds maps for 36 rotated copies of the crop and takes the best cell among all of them
Предсказывает угол регрессией: It predicts the angle by regression
Пробует повороты на роботе, пока деталь: It tries rotations on the robot until the part fits
Поворот — ещё одна ось карты. Поворот гн: Rotation is one more axis of the map. Rotating the socket shifts the peak along that axis, and the network needs no retraining.
Чем карта действий PerAct отличается от: How does PerAct's action map differ from Transporter's?
Она трёхмерная: оценка есть у каждого во: It is three-dimensional: every voxel above the table has a score, so the upper and lower shelves can be told apart
Она такая же, как у Transporter, только: It is the same as Transporter's, only built from four cameras
Она выдаёт координаты захвата регрессией: It outputs gripper coordinates by regression instead of a cell in the map
Сверху верхняя и нижняя полки — один пик: From above, the upper and lower shelves are the same pixel, and a table map cannot tell them apart. In a 100 × 100 × 100 grid every height has its own voxel, and the gripper rotation is chosen along three axes.
От точки на столе к позе в объёме: From a point on the table to a pose in the volume
Почему PerAct выдаёт только следующую кл: Why does PerAct output only the next keypose rather than an action on every frame?
Решений становится единицы вместо сотен,: There are a handful of decisions instead of hundreds, so errors have nowhere to pile up; a motion planner builds the path between poses
Сеть слишком медленная, чтобы выдавать д: The network is too slow to output an action on every frame
Камеры снимают сцену только в ключевых п: The cameras capture the scene only at keyposes
Ключевая поза — кадр, где рука стоит, а: A keypose is a frame where the arm is still and the gripper is not changing state. In the lab, 325 decisions shrank to six: approach, grasp, lift over the kettle, the spot in front of the shelf, release and retreat.
Демонстрации ставят чашку то на верхнюю,: The demonstrations put the cup sometimes on the upper shelf, sometimes on the lower one, and the command is just “put the cup on the shelf”. What does the voxel classifier output?
Два пика, по одному на каждой полке, и в: Two peaks, one per shelf, and it picks one of them
Один пик посередине между полками: One peak halfway between the shelves
Ровную карту: без названия полки он ниче: A flat map: without the shelf's name it learns nothing
Классификатор хранит распределение по во: The classifier keeps a distribution over voxels and does not average the correct answers. Regression in the same lab put the cup in mid-air between the shelves. A command that names the shelf leaves one peak.
Зачем PerAct нужен Perceiver, если есть: Why does PerAct need the Perceiver when there is the ordinary transformer?
Внимание всех ко всем по 8077 токенам не: All-to-all attention over 8,077 tokens does not fit in memory during training, while through 2,048 latents the cost grows linearly in the number of tokens
Perceiver лучше понимает текст команды,: The Perceiver understands the command text better because it was trained together with CLIP
Обычный трансформер не умеет работать с: The ordinary transformer cannot handle three-dimensional data
Кросс-внимание переносит вход в латенты,: Cross-attention moves the input into the latents, and all-to-all attention runs only among them. In the lab, the all-to-all attention scores over patches took 25 GB; the Perceiver's took 3.7 GB.
Просьба — «принеси чашку из шкафа», шкаф: The request is “bring the cup from the cabinet”, and the cabinet is closed. Usefulness from the language model: “take the cup from the cabinet” 0.5, “open the cabinet” 0.1. Feasibility from the value functions: 0.04 and 0.9. Which step does SayCan pick?
«Взять чашку из шкафа»: у него выше поле: “Take the cup from the cabinet”: it has the higher usefulness
Никакой: первый шаг рецепта невыполним,: None: the first step of the recipe is infeasible, and the plan stops
SayCan перемножает «полезно» и «выполним: SayCan multiplies “useful” by “feasible right now”. A step that is not in the recipe gets into the plan because the recipe cannot be carried out without it.
SayCan работает без обратной связи. Ада: SayCan runs without feedback. Ada grasps the cup, but it slips out of the gripper. What happens next?
План пойдёт дальше, будто чашка в захват: The plan carries on as if the cup were in the gripper: the language model considers the step done
SayCan повторит взятие: функция ценности: SayCan repeats the grasp: the value function sees that the gripper is empty
Ада остановится и спросит человека: Ada stops and asks a human
Языковая модель видит только просьбу и с: The language model sees only the request and the list of chosen steps. Inner Monologue appends the success detector's line to the prompt, and the model repeats the failed step.
Inner Monologue: результат шага — словам: Inner Monologue: the step's outcome in words
The command is “move the cube a little to the left”. Why does SayCan fail at it while Code as Policies succeeds?
SayCan выбирает только из обученных навы: SayCan only chooses among trained skills, while a program computes the new coordinate itself and calls “pick and place”
Code as Policies обучен на демонстрациях: Code as Policies was trained on demonstrations of shifts, and SayCan was not
SayCan не понимает слово «левее», а моде: SayCan does not understand the word “left”, and a code model does
Под каждую формулировку навык не обучишь: You cannot train a skill for every phrasing. A model trained on code turns “a little to the left” into a number: in the paper's examples “a little to the right” becomes +0.1 on the x coordinate.
Code as Policies: модель пишет программу: Code as Policies: the model writes a program
Расставь по порядку, как VoxPoser выполн: Put in order how VoxPoser carries out the request “open the top drawer and don't hit the vase”.
Языковая модель пишет код по просьбе: The language model writes code from the request
Код вызывает детекторы, и они находят ру: The code calls detectors, and they find the handle and the vase by name
Код заполняет карты притяжения к ручке и: The code fills in an attraction map toward the handle and an avoidance map around the vase
Планировщик ищет путь захвата с наименьш: The planner finds the lowest-cost gripper path over the weighted sum of the maps
Робот делает шаг по пути, и путь пересчи: The robot takes a step along the path, and the path is recomputed from a fresh image
Языковая модель решает, к чему тянуться: The language model decides what to reach for and what to avoid, but outputs not a single point of the path. The planner builds the path and recomputes it 5 times a second, and the code is re-run with fresh detector outputs without asking the model again.
VoxPoser: код строит карту, планировщик: VoxPoser: code builds the map, the planner builds the path
